title: Chandrayaan-3
description: India's third lunar exploration mission achieved successful soft landing near the Moon's south pole in August 2023, making India the fourth country to land on the lunar surface.

title: Mars Orbiter Mission (MOM)
description: Also known as Mangalyaan, this was India's first interplanetary mission launched in 2013. It successfully entered Mars orbit in its first attempt, making ISRO the fourth space agency to reach Mars.

title: Gaganyaan
description: India's first human spaceflight program aims to demonstrate human spaceflight capability by launching a crew of astronauts into a 400km orbit and bringing them safely back to earth.
